key_insight: pyDOF is a Python framework that automatically designs symmetric discrete forward and inverse filters under user-defined constraints.
engineering_relevance: It helps CFD and signal-processing users generate custom low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, and inverse filters without hand-tuning coefficients.
method: Constrained optimization for discrete filter transfer functions.
Adaptive stencil selection for filter design.
Van Cittert-based inverse filtering with user-controlled reconstruction order.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports automatic coefficient generation and plain-text export, but does not provide numerical benchmarks or validation metrics.
watch_item: Performance depends on how well the chosen constraints, stencil size, and inverse-filter order match the target application.
paper_title: pyDOF: a Python library for the design of discrete forward and inverse filters
